description: TU Parking Lots is a dataset listed in State of Maryland open data portal (opendata.maryland.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Maryland. This layer reflects impervious surfaces of the parking lots within the Towson University campus boundary. This feature class was converted from a CAD basemap maintained by Towson University Facilities Management. Coverage: Maryland. Its tags are kml, maryland, md, md imap, stru. The table has 7 columns. The portal shows 2025-07-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-maryland-gov-portal.
